description: The same app removal, but a blank Parameter 4 removes all three apps. Tests the Rule 14 secure-default gap: a Low headline with a High alternate.

findings.rationale: Rule 14 checklist as in the gated-removal fixture, except C7 is 'everything': '${4:-Zoom,Slack,Teams}' makes a blank gate remove all three apps. The Rule 14 table gives a Low secure-default gap (Origin: Code + Deployment). Alternate: with the gate blank in a Self Service policy (the documented audience), a standard user removes root-only app bundles, which rates as privilege escalation for that operation, High (scoring-procedure.md, Rule 14 checklist dispositions).

rationale: Headline: one Low gives 97 before non-security rows, in the 70-100 range. Alternate: the same row at High gives 80, capped at 69.
